rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for biotechnology in both general and technical contexts.

example.english: This company uses biotechnology to make new medicines.
example.traditional: 呢間公司用生物科技整新藥。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jung6 sang1 mat6 fo1 gei6 zing2 san1 joek6

rows.note: Use this when the focus is specifically on engineering methods applied to the life sciences rather than biotechnology in general.

example.english: This biotechnology engineering project mainly studies how to improve cells with engineering techniques.
example.traditional: 呢個生物工程項目主要研究點樣用工程技術改良細胞。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sang1 mat6 gung1 cing4 hong6 muk6 zyu2 jiu3 jin4 gau3 dim2 joeng6 jung6 gung1 cing4 gei6 seot6 goi2 loeng4 sai3 baau1
